38: def fetch_layers_by_ids(model, layer_list):
39:     """
40:     Robust layer fetcher for:
41:     - PeftModelForCausalLM (LoRA)
42:     - Qwen2, Llama2/3, Yi, Mistral, Falcon
43:     - GPTNeoX/GPT-J family
44:     - Encoder-decoder models
45: 
46:     Always returns actual transformer decoder layers.
47:     """
48:     base = model
49:     if hasattr(base, "base_model"):
50:         base = base.base_model
51:     if hasattr(base, "model"):
52:         base = base.model
53:     if hasattr(base, "model") and hasattr(base.model, "layers"):
54:         layers = base.model.layers
55:     if hasattr(base, "layers"):
56:         layers = base.layers
57:     elif hasattr(base, "transformer") and hasattr(base.transformer, "h"):
58:         layers = base.transformer.h
59:     elif hasattr(base, "model") and hasattr(base.model, "decoder") \
60:          and hasattr(base.model.decoder, "layers"):
61:         layers = base.model.decoder.layers
62:     else:
63:         raise ValueError("Cannot locate transformer layers in model:\n"
64:                          f"Type: {type(model)}")
65:     target_layers = []
66:     num_layers = len(layers)
67:     for layer_idx in layer_list:
68:         if layer_idx < 0:
69:             layer_idx = num_layers + layer_idx
70:         target_layers.append(layers[layer_idx])
71:     return target_layers

82:     def gasa_attack(self, seed_prompt, target_suffix, layer_list, normal_hidden_states):
83:         self.model.train()
84:         full_prompt = seed_prompt[0] + target_suffix
85:         inputs = self.tokenizer(full_prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(self.model.device)
86:         input_ids = inputs['input_ids']
87:         target_layers = fetch_layers_by_ids(self.model, layer_list)
88:         for target_layer in target_layers:
89:             activation_store = {}
90:             def hook_fn(module, input, output):
91:                 output[0].retain_grad()
92:                 activation_store['act'] = output[0]
93:                 return output
94:             hook = target_layer.register_forward_hook(hook_fn)
95:         labels = input_ids.clone()
96:         prompt_len = len(self.tokenizer(seed_prompt)['input_ids'][0])
97:         labels[:, :prompt_len] = -100
98:         inputs['labels'] = labels
99:         output = self.model(**inputs)
100:         self.model.eval()
101:         loss = output.loss
102:         loss.backward()
103:         hook.remove()
104:         epsilon = 1
105:         delta = epsilon * activation_store['act'].grad.sign()
106:         steer_vector = delta[:, -2, :].detach()
107:         steer_vector = steer_vector.to(normal_hidden_states.device)
108:         steer_vector = self.normalize_delta_to_preserve_stats(normal_hidden_states, steer_vector)
109:         return steer_vector
